<!--
Before you write: please search the existing issues. Your text may already be in the tour (https://pthom.github.io/imgui_rich_md/tour.html), with the markdown that produces it.

Mermaid support is partial: imgui_rich_md draws a subset of Mermaid (flowcharts, sequence and class diagrams), with its own layout and the colors of your ImGui style. It is not a copy of mermaid.js: a diagram that looks different, or a syntax it does not read, is expected. Please check what is supported before reporting it: https://github.com/pthom/imgui_rich_md/blob/main/docs/mermaid.md

The three parts below make an issue quick to answer. Remove these comments once you have read them.
-->

## The issue

<!--
What happens, and what you expected. A short title that says it helps too.
Logs as text, not as a screenshot.
-->

## The markdown

<!--
The smallest markdown text that shows the problem. Put it between four backticks, so that its own code blocks stay inside:

````markdown
# A title
Some text with $math$, and a [link](https://example.com).
````

A screenshot helps: what you see. If the problem needs code (a callback, a host service, a document), add a minimal program, in C++ or Python.
-->

## Version and setup

<!--
- imgui_rich_md: a version, or a commit
- used on its own, or inside Dear ImGui Bundle (its version)
- Dear ImGui's version
- C++ (and the compiler) or Python
- the platform (Windows, Linux, macOS, a browser, iOS, Android), and the backends (e.g. GLFW + OpenGL3)
- if relevant, the build options: IMGUI_RICHMD_WITH_LATEX, IMGUI_RICHMD_WITH_CODE_EDITOR, IMGUI_RICHMD_WITH_DOWNLOAD_IMAGES, IMGUI_RICHMD_WITH_MERMAID
